title: Mechanical Mass-Spring-Damper Bond Graph
description: 20-sim power bond graph of a forced mechanical mass-spring-damper oscillator sharing a common velocity 1-junction with integral SCAP causality across inertial I, compliant C, and resistive R elements.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<Document version="5.1">
  <Model name="MassSpringDamperBondGraph">
    <Submodels>
      <Submodel name="F_ext" type="Se" x="60" y="140">
        <Parameters>
          <Parameter name="effort" value="15.0" unit="N"/>
        </Parameters>
      </Submodel>
      <Submodel name="j_vel" type="1" x="200" y="140"/>
      <Submodel name="mass" type="I" x="340" y="60">
        <Parameters>
          <Parameter name="i" value="2.5" unit="kg"/>
        </Parameters>
      </Submodel>
      <Submodel name="damper" type="R" x="340" y="140">
        <Parameters>
          <Parameter name="r" value="1.8" unit="N*s/m"/>
        </Parameters>
      </Submodel>
      <Submodel name="spring" type="C" x="340" y="220">
        <Parameters>
          <Parameter name="c" value="0.05" unit="m/N"/>
        </Parameters>
      </Submodel>
    </Submodels>
    <Connections>
      <Connection id="b1" type="bond" from="F_ext.p" to="j_vel.p"/>
      <Connection id="b2" type="bond" from="j_vel.p" to="mass.p"/>
      <Connection id="b3" type="bond" from="j_vel.p" to="damper.p"/>
      <Connection id="b4" type="bond" from="j_vel.p" to="spring.p"/>
    </Connections>
    <Experiment startTime="0" finishTime="6" stepSize="0.005" method="RungeKutta4"/>
  </Model>
</Document>

title: RLC Electrical Circuit Power-Bond Equivalence
description: Series-parallel RLC electrical filter modeled in 20-sim power bond graph notation with voltage effort source, common-current 1-junction, common-voltage 0-junction, and load resistor.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<Document version="5.1">
  <Model name="RlcPowerBondCircuit">
    <Submodels>
      <Submodel name="V_in" type="Se" x="60" y="160">
        <Parameters>
          <Parameter name="effort" value="24.0" unit="V"/>
        </Parameters>
      </Submodel>
      <Submodel name="j1_series" type="1" x="180" y="160"/>
      <Submodel name="L_choke" type="I" x="180" y="60">
        <Parameters>
          <Parameter name="i" value="0.015" unit="H"/>
        </Parameters>
      </Submodel>
      <Submodel name="R_wire" type="R" x="180" y="260">
        <Parameters>
          <Parameter name="r" value="1.2" unit="Ohm"/>
        </Parameters>
      </Submodel>
      <Submodel name="j0_node" type="0" x="320" y="160"/>
      <Submodel name="C_filter" type="C" x="320" y="60">
        <Parameters>
          <Parameter name="c" value="0.00047" unit="F"/>
        </Parameters>
      </Submodel>
      <Submodel name="R_load" type="R" x="450" y="160">
        <Parameters>
          <Parameter name="r" value="12.0" unit="Ohm"/>
        </Parameters>
      </Submodel>
    </Submodels>
    <Connections>
      <Connection id="b1" type="bond" from="V_in.p" to="j1_series.p"/>
      <Connection id="b2" type="bond" from="j1_series.p" to="L_choke.p"/>
      <Connection id="b3" type="bond" from="j1_series.p" to="R_wire.p"/>
      <Connection id="b4" type="bond" from="j1_series.p" to="j0_node.p"/>
      <Connection id="b5" type="bond" from="j0_node.p" to="C_filter.p"/>
      <Connection id="b6" type="bond" from="j0_node.p" to="R_load.p"/>
    </Connections>
    <Experiment startTime="0" finishTime="0.2" stepSize="0.0002" method="RungeKutta4"/>
  </Model>
</Document>

title: DC Motor Electromechanical Gyrator Transducer
description: Permanent-magnet DC motor coupling an electrical armature RL circuit to a mechanical rotor inertia and viscous load via a power-conserving electromechanical gyrator (GY).
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<Document version="5.1">
  <Model name="DcMotorGyrator">
    <Submodels>
      <Submodel name="V_arm" type="Se" x="60" y="160">
        <Parameters>
          <Parameter name="effort" value="48.0" unit="V"/>
        </Parameters>
      </Submodel>
      <Submodel name="j1_elec" type="1" x="180" y="160"/>
      <Submodel name="R_arm" type="R" x="180" y="60">
        <Parameters>
          <Parameter name="r" value="0.85" unit="Ohm"/>
        </Parameters>
      </Submodel>
      <Submodel name="L_arm" type="I" x="180" y="260">
        <Parameters>
          <Parameter name="i" value="0.004" unit="H"/>
        </Parameters>
      </Submodel>
      <Submodel name="GY_motor" type="GY" x="320" y="160">
        <Parameters>
          <Parameter name="r" value="0.42" unit="N*m/A"/>
        </Parameters>
      </Submodel>
      <Submodel name="j1_mech" type="1" x="460" y="160"/>
      <Submodel name="J_rotor" type="I" x="460" y="60">
        <Parameters>
          <Parameter name="i" value="0.012" unit="kg*m^2"/>
        </Parameters>
      </Submodel>
      <Submodel name="B_load" type="R" x="460" y="260">
        <Parameters>
          <Parameter name="r" value="0.035" unit="N*m*s/rad"/>
        </Parameters>
      </Submodel>
    </Submodels>
    <Connections>
      <Connection id="b1" type="bond" from="V_arm.p" to="j1_elec.p"/>
      <Connection id="b2" type="bond" from="j1_elec.p" to="R_arm.p"/>
      <Connection id="b3" type="bond" from="j1_elec.p" to="L_arm.p"/>
      <Connection id="b4" type="bond" from="j1_elec.p" to="GY_motor.p1"/>
      <Connection id="b5" type="bond" from="GY_motor.p2" to="j1_mech.p"/>
      <Connection id="b6" type="bond" from="j1_mech.p" to="J_rotor.p"/>
      <Connection id="b7" type="bond" from="j1_mech.p" to="B_load.p"/>
    </Connections>
    <Experiment startTime="0" finishTime="2.0" stepSize="0.001" method="RungeKutta4"/>
  </Model>
</Document>

title: Hydraulic Pump-Accumulator-Cylinder Multi-Domain Bond Graph
description: Multi-domain electro-hydraulic power transmission linking a rotary drive through a positive-displacement pump transformer (TF), hydraulic accumulator compliance, orifice resistance, and piston cylinder actuator.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<Document version="5.1">
  <Model name="HydraulicPumpCylinder">
    <Submodels>
      <Submodel name="T_drive" type="Se" x="40" y="160">
        <Parameters>
          <Parameter name="effort" value="85.0" unit="N*m"/>
        </Parameters>
      </Submodel>
      <Submodel name="j1_shaft" type="1" x="150" y="160"/>
      <Submodel name="J_pump" type="I" x="150" y="60">
        <Parameters>
          <Parameter name="i" value="0.04" unit="kg*m^2"/>
        </Parameters>
      </Submodel>
      <Submodel name="TF_pump" type="TF" x="270" y="160">
        <Parameters>
          <Parameter name="r" value="0.000018" unit="m^3/rad"/>
        </Parameters>
      </Submodel>
      <Submodel name="j0_manifold" type="0" x="390" y="160"/>
      <Submodel name="C_accum" type="C" x="390" y="60">
        <Parameters>
          <Parameter name="c" value="1.2e-10" unit="m^3/Pa"/>
        </Parameters>
      </Submodel>
      <Submodel name="R_leak" type="R" x="390" y="260">
        <Parameters>
          <Parameter name="r" value="2.5e10" unit="Pa*s/m^3"/>
        </Parameters>
      </Submodel>
      <Submodel name="TF_piston" type="TF" x="520" y="160">
        <Parameters>
          <Parameter name="r" value="0.0025" unit="m^2"/>
        </Parameters>
      </Submodel>
      <Submodel name="j1_load" type="1" x="640" y="160"/>
      <Submodel name="M_load" type="I" x="640" y="60">
        <Parameters>
          <Parameter name="i" value="120.0" unit="kg"/>
        </Parameters>
      </Submodel>
      <Submodel name="R_fric" type="R" x="640" y="260">
        <Parameters>
          <Parameter name="r" value="450.0" unit="N*s/m"/>
        </Parameters>
      </Submodel>
    </Submodels>
    <Connections>
      <Connection id="b1" type="bond" from="T_drive.p" to="j1_shaft.p"/>
      <Connection id="b2" type="bond" from="j1_shaft.p" to="J_pump.p"/>
      <Connection id="b3" type="bond" from="j1_shaft.p" to="TF_pump.p1"/>
      <Connection id="b4" type="bond" from="TF_pump.p2" to="j0_manifold.p"/>
      <Connection id="b5" type="bond" from="j0_manifold.p" to="C_accum.p"/>
      <Connection id="b6" type="bond" from="j0_manifold.p" to="R_leak.p"/>
      <Connection id="b7" type="bond" from="j0_manifold.p" to="TF_piston.p1"/>
      <Connection id="b8" type="bond" from="TF_piston.p2" to="j1_load.p"/>
      <Connection id="b9" type="bond" from="j1_load.p" to="M_load.p"/>
      <Connection id="b10" type="bond" from="j1_load.p" to="R_fric.p"/>
    </Connections>
    <Experiment startTime="0" finishTime="3.0" stepSize="0.001" method="RungeKutta4"/>
  </Model>
</Document>

title: Active Quarter-Car Hydropneumatic Suspension
description: Two-DOF quarter-car bond graph modeling sprung chassis mass, unsprung wheel hub mass, tire vertical compliance, primary suspension spring-damper, and a companion skyhook active damping controller submodel.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<Document version="5.1">
  <Model name="ActiveQuarterCarSuspension">
    <Submodels>
      <Submodel name="v_road" type="Sf" x="40" y="200">
        <Parameters>
          <Parameter name="flow" value="0.15" unit="m/s"/>
        </Parameters>
      </Submodel>
      <Submodel name="j0_tire" type="0" x="150" y="200"/>
      <Submodel name="C_tire" type="C" x="150" y="80">
        <Parameters>
          <Parameter name="c" value="5.0e-6" unit="m/N"/>
        </Parameters>
      </Submodel>
      <Submodel name="j1_unsprung" type="1" x="280" y="200"/>
      <Submodel name="M_wheel" type="I" x="280" y="80">
        <Parameters>
          <Parameter name="i" value="42.0" unit="kg"/>
        </Parameters>
      </Submodel>
      <Submodel name="j0_susp" type="0" x="410" y="200"/>
      <Submodel name="C_susp" type="C" x="410" y="80">
        <Parameters>
          <Parameter name="c" value="3.5e-5" unit="m/N"/>
        </Parameters>
      </Submodel>
      <Submodel name="R_susp" type="R" x="410" y="320">
        <Parameters>
          <Parameter name="r" value="2400.0" unit="N*s/m"/>
        </Parameters>
      </Submodel>
      <Submodel name="j1_sprung" type="1" x="550" y="200"/>
      <Submodel name="M_chassis" type="I" x="550" y="80">
        <Parameters>
          <Parameter name="i" value="360.0" unit="kg"/>
        </Parameters>
      </Submodel>
      <Submodel name="R_skyhook" type="R" x="550" y="320">
        <Parameters>
          <Parameter name="r" value="1800.0" unit="N*s/m"/>
        </Parameters>
      </Submodel>
    </Submodels>
    <Connections>
      <Connection id="b1" type="bond" from="v_road.p" to="j0_tire.p"/>
      <Connection id="b2" type="bond" from="j0_tire.p" to="C_tire.p"/>
      <Connection id="b3" type="bond" from="j0_tire.p" to="j1_unsprung.p"/>
      <Connection id="b4" type="bond" from="j1_unsprung.p" to="M_wheel.p"/>
      <Connection id="b5" type="bond" from="j1_unsprung.p" to="j0_susp.p"/>
      <Connection id="b6" type="bond" from="j0_susp.p" to="C_susp.p"/>
      <Connection id="b7" type="bond" from="j0_susp.p" to="R_susp.p"/>
      <Connection id="b8" type="bond" from="j0_susp.p" to="j1_sprung.p"/>
      <Connection id="b9" type="bond" from="j1_sprung.p" to="M_chassis.p"/>
      <Connection id="b10" type="bond" from="j1_sprung.p" to="R_skyhook.p"/>
    </Connections>
    <Experiment startTime="0" finishTime="4.0" stepSize="0.002" method="RungeKutta4"/>
  </Model>
</Document>
